Defeated of expectations or hope; experiencing disappointment; let down.

examples.text: After all his anticipation, the trip left him deeply disappointed.
If they came to hear me beg, they will be disappointed.

glosses: Defeated of expectations or hope; experiencing disappointment; let down.
Having had a marriage proposal rejected.

examples.text: Scattered here and there amongst the steerage passengers were men of a different class: men whose previous lives had not fitted them for the hard and uncertain lot that certainly lay before them - pale-faced boys from Melbourne shops; middle-aged and disappointed men; one and all hoping for a turn of luck in the lottery of the newly-discovered goldfield.
